name: GET answered at once with JSON: the request goes out and the answer lands in the same settle — Response, Status Code, Response Headers, done
because: httpnode.ts :494-500 (one request at the frame's end), :1152-1155 (Auto parses application/json), :995-1040, :1160-1162. NSP-007 AC3: the request is in the trace

name: an answer 100 ms away: the request in one settle, nothing at 99, the answer at 100 (the absence beside the firing arm)
because: world.ts NETWORK `after`; NSP-007 AC2's shape for a request

name: a 404 takes the Failure path with http/error-status, Error = 'HTTP 404: Not Found', and the body still lands on Response
because: httpnode.ts :1163-1170. NSP-007 AC3: a failing response takes the Failure path with the contract's `failed`

name: a request that never reaches a server: Failure http/network-error, Error = the error's message, no output moves
because: httpnode.ts :1191-1203

name: no answer and Timeout 1000: at 999 nothing, at 1000 the timeout aborts it — Failure http/timeout, Error names the timeout, no Canceled
because: httnode.ts :1075-1078, :1194-1203 (NDA-012: a timeout is not a cancel)

name: Cancel in flight: done at once; next settle Canceled and the Fetch's unchanged. Cancel with nothing in flight: unchanged
because: httpnode.ts :522-531 cancelFetch, :1181-1190 the AbortError branch

name: no URL: Failure http/no-url with Error 'URL is required', and no request goes out
because: httpnode.ts :1062-1071

name: POST with two JSON body fields, a header and a query parameter, and a {id} path parameter: the request as it travels
because: httpnode.ts :852-903 buildUrl, :905-927 buildHeaders, :929-968 buildBody json, :1087-1089 the Content-Type it adds

name: URL-encoded and form bodies: the encoding travels; a null field is omitted by both
because: httpnode.ts :969-985; the empty-value contract (:107-109)

name: a 304 pulses Not Modified and settles unchanged; Response keeps the previous body
because: httpnode.ts :1116-1126 (FED-004)

name: Response Type JSON on a body that is not JSON: Failure, Error says so — under http/bad-body (v4, D11)
because: httpnode.ts badBody: the parse failure is marked and the .catch reports HTTP_ERROR_CODES.badBody (P109 ISL-030, P107-D11 ruled "Give it its own code"); v3 used the network error's code

name: Auto on an application/json answer that is not JSON: Failure under http/bad-body (v4, D11)
because: httpnode.ts `response.json()` rejected → badBody; the message is the parser's, as it was

name: two Fetch pulses in one frame: ONE request, two dones
because: httpnode.ts :494-500 scheduleFetch's same-pass guard coalesces the work, never the outcomes (:480-490)

name: two Cancels in one frame: the first aborts and reports done, the second finds the controller already gone and reports unchanged
because: httpnode.ts :522-531 — `abortController = null` synchronously in cancelFetch

name: an earlier request's completion no longer disarms Cancel for a later one (v5, D12): the aborted first request's landing removes only its own handle, and the second Cancel aborts the second request
because: httpnode.ts abortControllers — one per request, each removed by its own completion (P109 ISL-030, P107-D12 ruled "Every request still running"); v4 kept one controller, cleared by ANY completion

name: a 304 for the first request leaves Cancel able to abort the second (v5, D12): Not Modified lands while the second is in flight, then Cancel aborts the second
because: httpnode.ts: the then removes only its own request's controller, before the 304 branch (v5, D12)

name: a request answered 304, then Cancel: nothing is in flight, so Unchanged (v5, D12)
because: httpnode.ts: the 304 branch removes its own request's controller (v5, D12), so Cancel finds nothing running

name: two requests in flight: one Cancel aborts both, each answering on Canceled (v5, D12)
because: httpnode.ts cancelFetch aborts every controller still in the set, in the order the requests were sent (P107-D12 ruled "Every request still running")

name: Bearer authentication sends Authorization: Bearer <token> (v3, C7)
because: httpnode.ts authInputs → authConfigurators.bearer (P109 ISL-030, P107-C7 ruled "Fix it, send the credential"); v2 sent no Authorization: the presets read inputs.authToken, the port stores auth-authToken

name: Basic authentication sends the encoded user name and password (v3, C7)
because: authConfigurators.basic — Authorization: Basic base64(user:password)

name: API Key in a header sends the header it names (v3, C7)
because: authConfigurators.apiKey — Add To unset is the header

name: API Key as a query parameter goes on the URL (v3, C7)
because: authConfigurators.apiKey with Add To = query → buildUrl appends it after the query ports

name: a non-string URL fails the Fetch with http/input-not-text and Error 'URL is not text' (C8); nothing goes out, and the node still works afterwards
because: P107-C8, ruled 2026-10-05 "Fail and say which input", fixed in P109 ISL-026 (v2); httpnode.ts once drained the tokens (:1050-1051) and threw at :1069 `.match`, swallowed at nodecontext.ts :472

name: text after a unit object on Headers arrives as sent: the Fetch sends its request (no headers) and answers Done (ISL-026, C6)
because: was NSP-011 §6 C6 (R7): node.ts setInputValue merged a later value into a unit object on ANY port; since ISL-026 only a port whose type declares units merges — reduced by hand from generated seed 73021029 on run seed 777 (s12, the first rotation that drew it)

name: Headers wired a number, with a POST: the Fetch fails naming Headers (C8)
because: P107-C8, ruled 2026-10-05 "Fail and say which input", fixed in P109 ISL-026; the runtime once threw at `.split` inside doFetch and the Fetch was never answered
